:::{#exm-Cox_Sample_Size}
## Statistical Power and Sample Size for a Cox Proportional Hazards Model
Suppose an oncology trial compares an active treatment with control on progression-free survival, analysed with a Cox proportional hazards model. Here the statistical power depends on the number of events observed, not directly on the number of participants. We assume:

- a target hazard ratio $\text{HR} = 0.80$ (a 20% reduction in the hazard),
- two-sided $\alpha = 0.05$ and 90% power,
- 1:1 allocation.
:::
